prompt: One of the most underrated products in a man’s

2010 wardrobe is the shirt.
For many men, shirts take any thought at all because they don’t require any planning other than picking the right size and the right color. Unfortunately the same cannot be said for “men only” shirts. These shirts might get tossed into the dressier section without any regard to whether the man will wear the shirt with any sort of formality. Most men have seen the image of the suit jacket and tie and the dress shirt being thrown with such carelessness. The truth is though that men’s shirts offer more utility than just dress shirting. I am not suggesting men change to dress shirt – dress shirts have their own use and are just as important. However, for you and me who really don’t have an occasion more dressy than the office, you might want to consider having a few additional shirts other than the solid color.
